options.B: 5 years after the company started selling clothes online, its predicted annual revenue will have increased by a total of approximately 648,650 dollars.

options.B: Plausible values for the average weight of all bags of walnuts filled by the machine are less than 10.97 ounces or greater than 11.37 ounces.
options.C: The average weight of all bags of walnuts filled by the machine is less than 11.02 ounces.
options.D: The average weight of all bags of walnuts filled by the machine is greater than 11.02 ounces.
